choices.reason: No rule separates the candidates: the paper's primary hypothesis and main finding concern LLM use versus manual reframing, and no individual AI-versus-AI novelty contrast is singled out as primary or main. These are full-sample contrasts from the same session with no standardizable outcome statistics or data_stats; FREE-FORM is the comparator in two candidates, while DIRECT and STRUCTURED both use prescribed, button-based prompts, so the chatbot-use preference supplies no unique selection.
choices.locator: PDF pp. 1-2, Abstract and Section 1; p. 4, Section 3.1; pp. 7-8, Sections 4.5 and 5 (quoted passage on p. 8); p. 17, Appendix A.
choices.quote: Secondly, to understand the influence of different ways of using LLMs, we made comparisons among the manual, direct, structured, and free-form approaches.
